std_auc_definition: population standard deviation (ddof=0) across 7 LOSO fold AUCs
paper_reported_std_auc_definition: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across 7 LOSO fold AUCs

edge_attribute_semantics.note: Signed FC Pearson correlation values are stored as edge attributes in the PyG Data objects with self-loops; however, during message passing in the main 7-fold LOSO benchmark, only isotropic GCN consumes edge_weight=edge_weight. GAT, SAGE, and GIN perform unweighted message passing on edge_index.
